title: Gguf Export
definition: The process of converting a fine-tuned large language model into a compact format (GGUF) for efficient deployment and local use.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A way to pack a computer model into a smaller format for easy use on your own computer, like turning a large library book into a portable e-book.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The process of converting a fine-tuned large language model into a compact GGUF format for efficient deployment and local use.
difficulty_levels.expert: The process of converting a fine-tuned large language model into a compact GGUF format, enabling efficient deployment and local use, as well as reducing model dependencies.

extra_fields.insight: The conversion of a fine-tuned large language model into a compact GGUF format for efficient deployment and local use.
